## Modules

- [TimelessMetrics](https://timeless-metrics.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetrics.md): Embedded time series storage for Elixir.
- [TimelessMetrics.Aggregation](https://timeless-metrics.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetrics.Aggregation.md): Shared aggregation helpers for the actor engine.
- [TimelessMetrics.Alert](https://timeless-metrics.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetrics.Alert.md): Alert engine that evaluates threshold rules against metric data.
- [TimelessMetrics.AlertEvaluator](https://timeless-metrics.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetrics.AlertEvaluator.md): Periodic alert evaluation timer.
- [TimelessMetrics.Anomaly](https://timeless-metrics.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetrics.Anomaly.md): Anomaly detection via z-score analysis on residuals from a trend model.
- [TimelessMetrics.Application](https://timeless-metrics.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetrics.Application.md)
- [TimelessMetrics.Buffer](https://timeless-metrics.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetrics.Buffer.md): Sharded ETS write buffer.
- [TimelessMetrics.Chart](https://timeless-metrics.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetrics.Chart.md): Pure-Elixir SVG chart generator for time series data.
- [TimelessMetrics.DB](https://timeless-metrics.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetrics.DB.md): SQLite connection manager with a single writer and pooled readers.
- [TimelessMetrics.Dashboard](https://timeless-metrics.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetrics.Dashboard.md): Zero-dependency HTML dashboard generator.
- [TimelessMetrics.DataGenerator](https://timeless-metrics.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetrics.DataGenerator.md): Realistic telemetry data generators for benchmarks and testing.
- [TimelessMetrics.DictTrainer](https://timeless-metrics.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetrics.DictTrainer.md): Manages zstd dictionaries for legacy compressed segments.
- [TimelessMetrics.Forecast](https://timeless-metrics.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetrics.Forecast.md): Time series forecasting using linear regression with seasonal features.
- [TimelessMetrics.HTTP](https://timeless-metrics.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetrics.HTTP.md): Optional HTTP ingest interface compatible with VictoriaMetrics JSON line import format.
- [TimelessMetrics.IngestWorker](https://timeless-metrics.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetrics.IngestWorker.md): Background ingest worker that drains raw HTTP bodies from an ETS queue,
parses them, resolves series, and writes to Buffer shards.
- [TimelessMetrics.PromQL](https://timeless-metrics.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetrics.PromQL.md): PromQL parser and executor for TSBS DevOps query patterns.
- [TimelessMetrics.PrometheusNif](https://timeless-metrics.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetrics.PrometheusNif.md): NIF-based Prometheus text format parser.
- [TimelessMetrics.Query](https://timeless-metrics.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetrics.Query.md): Query engine with automatic tier selection.
- [TimelessMetrics.Retention](https://timeless-metrics.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetrics.Retention.md): Tier-aware retention enforcer.
- [TimelessMetrics.Rollup](https://timeless-metrics.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetrics.Rollup.md): Sharded rollup engine.
- [TimelessMetrics.RustEngine](https://timeless-metrics.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetrics.RustEngine.md): Rust-native storage engine backend for TimelessMetrics.
- [TimelessMetrics.Schema](https://timeless-metrics.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetrics.Schema.md): Declarative DSL for defining metric storage tiers, retention, and rollup schedules.
- [TimelessMetrics.SegmentBuilder](https://timeless-metrics.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetrics.SegmentBuilder.md): Accumulates points per series and writes compressed segments to file-based
storage (ShardStore).
- [TimelessMetrics.SeriesRegistry](https://timeless-metrics.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetrics.SeriesRegistry.md): Hybrid persistent_term + ETS series ID lookup and registration.
- [TimelessMetrics.ShardStore](https://timeless-metrics.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetrics.ShardStore.md): File-based storage backend for raw time series segments and tier chunks.
- [TimelessMetrics.TextCodec](https://timeless-metrics.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetrics.TextCodec.md): RLE + zstd compression codec for text time-series.
- [TimelessMetrics.TierChunk](https://timeless-metrics.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetrics.TierChunk.md): Codec for compressed tier segments.
- [TimelessMetrics.Transform](https://timeless-metrics.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetrics.Transform.md): Post-query value transforms for unit conversion.
